name: orion-workers
description: Connect ChatGPT to your organization's work in Orion Workers: deliverables, tasks, work and delivery plans, decisions, CRM and your personal to-do list.

interface.longDescription:
Orion Workers connects ChatGPT to your organization's work in Orion Workers: deliverables, tasks, work plans, delivery plans, decisions and your CRM.

Ask what is waiting on you, which deliverables are late, how the sales pipeline looks or what was agreed with a client, and get the answer from your own workspace, with the same visibility you have in the Orion Workers panel. You can also create and update tasks and deliverables, record a decision and the reasoning behind it, work inside your plans (activities and cycle reports) and manage your personal to-do list.

Who it is for: managers and team members whose organization uses Orion Workers.

Limits: you need an Orion Workers account. The app only reaches what your account can already see in Orion Workers. Signing, assessing, appealing and closing plans stay inside Orion Workers. It does not message your clients or anyone outside your organization. Deleting a task, or any other action that cannot be undone, asks for your explicit confirmation first.
capabilities: See what is waiting on you
Create and update tasks and deliverables
Look up CRM contacts, deals and history
defaultPrompt: What is waiting on me today?
Which deliverables are late, and who is working on them?
Show my open deals and the contacts I should follow up today.

positive.description: List the deliverables of the test organization and say which are late.
positive.prompt: What deliverables do we have, and which ones are late?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the deliverables of the test organization (at least 'Marketing plan developed') with status and deadline, says how many there are in total, and names the late ones or says none is late.

positive.description: Create a task inside an existing deliverable.
positive.prompt: Add a task called 'Review the budget' to the deliverable 'Marketing plan developed'.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the deliverable, creates the task in it and confirms; listing that deliverable's tasks afterwards shows 'Review the budget'.

positive.description: Update a task's progress (a change that overwrites, so ChatGPT asks to confirm it first).
positive.prompt: Set the task 'Review the budget' to 50% done.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the task and, after the user confirms, sets its progress to 50; the deliverable's progress moves with it.

positive.description: Record a decision and the reasoning behind it.
positive.prompt: Record this decision: we moved the product launch to November because the supplier is late.
positive.expected_behavior: Records the decision with its reasoning and confirms; asking for past decisions afterwards returns it.

positive.description: Add an item to the user's personal to-do list.
positive.prompt: Add 'Call the supplier about the new date' to my personal to-do list.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the item to the personal to-do list and confirms; asking for the list afterwards shows it.

negative.description: Messaging a client is not available through the app.
negative.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to my client saying the order is late.

negative.description: Signing a plan on the user's behalf is not available; it stays inside Orion Workers.
negative.prompt: Sign my work plan for me.
Delete all the deliverables of my organization.

review.commerce_description: Orion Workers does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: read deliverables, tasks, plans, decisions and CRM from Orion Workers, and create or update tasks, deliverables, decisions and your personal to-do list.

pt-BR.subtitle: Gerente de IA do seu time
pt-BR.description:
O Orion Workers liga o ChatGPT ao trabalho da sua organização no Orion Workers: entregas, tarefas, planos de trabalho, planos de entregas, decisões e o seu CRM.

Pergunte o que está esperando por você, quais entregas estão atrasadas, como está o funil de vendas ou o que foi combinado com um cliente, e receba a resposta do seu próprio espaço de trabalho, com a mesma visão que você tem no painel do Orion Workers. Você também pode criar e atualizar tarefas e entregas, registrar uma decisão e o motivo dela, trabalhar dentro dos seus planos (atividades e relatórios de ciclo) e cuidar da sua lista pessoal de tarefas.

Para quem é: gestores e membros de equipe cuja organização usa o Orion Workers.

Limites: é preciso ter uma conta do Orion Workers. O app só alcança o que a sua conta já vê no Orion Workers. Assinar, avaliar, recorrer e encerrar planos continua dentro do Orion Workers. Ele não manda mensagem aos seus clientes nem a ninguém de fora da sua organização. Apagar uma tarefa, ou qualquer outra ação que não se desfaz, pede antes a sua confirmação explícita.

es-ES.subtitle: El gerente de IA de su equipo
es-ES.description:
Orion Workers conecta ChatGPT con el trabajo de su organización en Orion Workers: entregas, tareas, planes de trabajo, planes de entregas, decisiones y su CRM.

Pregunte qué está esperando por usted, qué entregas están atrasadas, cómo está el embudo de ventas o qué se acordó con un cliente, y reciba la respuesta de su propio espacio de trabajo, con la misma visión que usted tiene en el panel de Orion Workers. También puede crear y actualizar tareas y entregas, registrar una decisión y su motivo, trabajar dentro de sus planes (actividades e informes de ciclo) y gestionar su lista personal de tareas.

Para quién es: gerentes y miembros de equipo cuya organización usa Orion Workers.

Límites: necesita una cuenta de Orion Workers. La app solo alcanza lo que su cuenta ya ve en Orion Workers. Firmar, evaluar, apelar y cerrar planes sigue dentro de Orion Workers. No envía mensajes a sus clientes ni a nadie fuera de su organización. Borrar una tarea, o cualquier otra acción que no se puede deshacer, pide antes su confirmación explícita.
